yaml_frontmatter.title: Petroleum Inventory Trajectories Under the 2026 Strait of Hormuz Closure: A Mass-Balance Forecast Model [cite: 2, 3, 4, 5]
yaml_frontmatter.description: A Mass-Balance Forecast Model with Sensitivity Analysis and Falsifiable Predictions

abstract: This paper develops a weekly mass-balance forecasting model for U.S. petroleum inventories during the 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure crisis[cite: 9]. The model identifies calendar dates when inventories cross operational floors, forecasting a national motor gasoline floor crossing of July 17, 2026[cite: 10].

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.content: On 28 February 2026, the United States and Israel initiated a coordinated air campaign against the Islamic Republic of Iran, resulting in the closure of the Strait of Hormuz[cite: 19, 20]. The supply shock has been partially absorbed by accelerated drawdowns of U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve and record exports[cite: 24].

sections.heading: 2. Background and Institutional Context
sections.content: The Strait of Hormuz closure acts as an exogenous shock[cite: 52]. The Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR) has an authorized capacity of 714 million barrels, with a maximum sustained drawdown rate of approximately 4.4 million barrels per day[cite: 63, 65].

sections.heading: 3. Data Sources
sections.content: Data is primarily drawn from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), including the Weekly Petroleum Status Report and Short-Term Energy Outlook[cite: 85, 88].

rmarkdown_table.description: Table 1: Data sources used in the model[cite: 94].

```{r data-sources, echo=FALSE, layout="l-body-outset"}
library(knitr)
library(rmarkdown)
data_sources <- data.frame(
  Source = c('EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report', 'EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook', 'U.S. DOE / Office of Petroleum Reserves'),
  Variables = c('Crude production, imports, refinery inputs, all stock levels', '2026 production forecast, price forecast, refinery utilization', 'SPR site-level inventory; release schedule'),
  Frequency = c('Weekly', 'Monthly', 'Weekly')
)
paged_table(data_sources)
```

sections.heading: 4. Mathematical Model
sections.content: The model is a deterministic, weekly-resolution mass-balance accounting framework[cite: 102]. The mass balance equation for the Strategic Petroleum Reserve is $S_S(t+1)=S_S(t)-r_S(t)$[cite: 114]. The floor-crossing time $T^*_i$ is defined as $$T^*_i=\min\{t\in\mathbb{N}:S_i(t)<F_i\}$$[cite: 135, 136].

sections.heading: 5. Baseline Forecast
sections.content: Motor gasoline is forecast to enter the operational-floor regime nationally on July 17, 2026 (week 11), at 213.9 MMbbl[cite: 178, 180]. Distillate is already below the floor as of May 1, 2026[cite: 178].
